    prefix_sum = [0] * (n + 1)
    for i in range(1, n + 1):

    max_sum = float('-inf')

    prefix_sum_mod = {}

    for i in range(n):

            end = i

            prefix_sum_mod[mod] = i
    return arr[start:end + 1]
